item.title: Curtain Call at the Gaslight Theatre: A Murder Mystery Logic Grid
item.description:
Clue seven puts Mr. Bramwell and Mrs. Penrose on the bottom two floors of the dressing-room tower, one each, no telling which. Clue one says Bramwell didn’t dress on the first floor. You draw your first ● with some satisfaction. Then clue four turns that floor into an entrance cue, and suddenly a second block of the grid starts filling in too.

That chain reaction is what this case is about. There are two ordered categories here, acts and floors, and the clues keep passing information between them. Every actor had exactly one prop, one first entrance and one dressing-room floor. Eight clues, no guessing, and somewhere in the grid is the person who poisoned the goblet.
